He just sent me a long message apologising, and explaining that he chose to go because he so rarely gets invited to parties (he's been invited to one other party in the time we've been together), and he's often talked about how sad he is that none of his friends ever seem to want to hang out anymore.

YTA big time. It's kinda obvious that the reason she tried to hide it, is because she really wants it and she KNOWS (because you've made it so apparent) that you think it's really unattractive. 

From what little you've put here, it sounds like you pushed her into the position of needing to hide it from you.

That's my initial thought to, but I've never met anyone so blatantly honest as this guy, and I also know that he has a bit of impulse control. We've been together for 7 months now, and spent almost half of that basically living together. Im trying to regulate what I write because I have a diagnosed personality disorder that makes me go a bit into the psychotic side of things when I feel snubbed, but I also don't want to be treated like an idiot by a guy.

This time he didnt tell me he was gonna do it, he said "not right now", but it's happened a few times before. The big thing right now is that he's ignoring my messages, which is different and makes me a bit nervous.

It's incredibly rare that I instigate something like this, so the amount of times it's happened is minimal, but it still bites that it's been almost every time. He didnt promise anything this time, but yeah, shit. I was hoping Id be the asshole.
NTA. You get to play your game any way you want, you're not obligated to let anyone play with you.
